# Assistive robotics arc
#
# People whose stories center on robots that adapt to human bodies and care
# needs — not only package delivery.

arc: assistive_robotics
map: Small_City_LVL

stories:
  - person: noor_rahman
    story: noor_accessible_reroute
    focus: wheelchair + robotaxi that reroutes to an accessible bay
    comfort_score: 0.72

  - person: mei_lin
    story: mei_assist_market
    focus: paired assist-cart companion (carry + guide + yield)
    comfort_score: 0.78

  - person: rosa_delgado
    story: rosa_clinic_ramp
    focus: caregiver + elder; ramp clearance (assistive design failure)
    comfort_score: 0.25
    note: Contrast case — when robots do not assist.

design_rules:
  - Accessibility is route data, not an apology after a failed stop.
  - Assistive robots stay paired; delivery robots must not split the pair.
  - Ramps and curb cuts are shared critical infrastructure.
  - Silent machines fail people who cannot hear or move aside quickly.

play:
  - people/noor_rahman/journey.yaml
  - people/mei_lin/journey.yaml
  - people/rosa_delgado/journey.yaml
